Requires certified eligibility application with healthcare-professional verification (Part A/Part B); temporary eligibility granted pending determination (within 21 days). Reservations required at least one day in advance.

Name: Hele-On Ka Hoʻokele (Rural Door-to-Door Service)
Region/Service Area: Rural areas outside Hele-On fixed routes: Seaview/Kalapana, Upper Puna, Waimea, Hilo, Kailua-Kona, Captain Cook; Island of Hawaiʻi
Operator: Hawaiʻi County Economic Opportunity Council (HCEOC), operating for the County of Hawaiʻi Mass Transit Agency
Service Hours: Monday-Friday 7:30 AM to 4:30 PM, excluding County-observed holidays
Funding Source: Local (County of Hawaiʻi Mass Transit Agency)
Ridership/Performance Notes: Open to the general public who reside in rural areas outside regular fixed-route and paratransit coverage. Registration required; reservations at (808) 731-7009 option 3, minimum one day in advance, up to 14 days ahead. Riders travel within a district or are taken to the nearest Hele-On fixed-route stop for onward travel.

Name: Hele-On Kākoʻo Paratransit
Region/Service Area: Island of Hawaiʻi — Hilo, Puna, and Kailua-Kona service areas (within 3/4 mile of fixed-route stops); Hawaiʻi County
Operator: MTM Transit under contract to County of Hawaiʻi Mass Transit Agency
Fare: Free (all Hele-On services fare-free through Dec 31, 2028)
Service Hours: Hilo Mon-Sat 6:00 a.m.-8:00 p.m., Sun 9:15 a.m.-6:00 p.m.; Kailua-Kona daily 6:00 a.m.-9:00 p.m.; Puna Mon-Fri 5:30 a.m.-10:05 p.m., Sat/Sun 6:30 a.m.-9:15 p.m.
Fleet: Not specified (MTM local staff of 13; offices in Hilo and Kailua-Kona; parent Hele-On fleet 30+ buses/vans/trolley)
Ridership/Performance Notes: ADA complementary origin-to-destination paratransit for riders unable to use fixed-route Hele-On. MTM Transit contract went live Jan 1, 2023. Rides booked via the Via-built 'Hele-On Kakoʻo Paratransit' app (iOS/Android) or reservation line 808-640-1020 (island-wide daily 7:45 a.m.-4:30 p.m.); advance/next-day reservations. Eligibility functional, not diagnosis/age/income based.

Name: Maui Bus ADA Paratransit Service
Region/Service Area: Corridors extending 3/4-mile on each side of fixed Maui Bus routes (central, south, west, Haʻiku, Kula, Upcountry), Maui County, HI
Operator: Maui Economic Opportunity, Inc. (MEO Transportation) for the County of Maui Department of Transportation
Fare: $2.00 one-way; 12-ride ticket book $20.00; PCA and service animal ride free
Service Hours: Same as fixed-route Maui Bus (approx. 5:30 AM–10:00 PM depending on location, daily incl. holidays); reservation line 8:00 AM–4:00 PM daily
Funding Source: Federal, Local (County of Maui; ADA complementary paratransit)
Ridership/Performance Notes: Advance-reservation, curb-to-curb ADA paratransit for those unable to use fixed-route Maui Bus. Reservations (808) 877-7651; up to 14 days in advance, at least one day prior by 4:00 PM for next-day service. MEO awarded a 5-year County contract in 2023.

Name: Seniors and Persons with Disabilities Demand Response Transportation (Hele-On / Hawaiʻi County)
Operator: Hawaii County Economic Opportunity Council (HCEOC), under contract to the County of Hawaiʻi Mass Transit Agency
Funding Source: Local (County of Hawaiʻi Mass Transit Agency)
Ridership/Performance Notes: Eligibility-restricted demand-response for seniors age 60+ and persons with disabilities; contracted to HCEOC by the County of Hawaiʻi Mass Transit Agency. Provides access to medical facilities, rehabilitation centers, nutrition sites, shopping, banks, post offices, government buildings and employment. Distinct from Hele-On Ka Hoʻokele (general-public rural door-to-door) and Hele-On Kakoʻo ADA paratransit (operated by MTM Transit). Contact HCEOC Transportation Division 808-731-7009.

Name: The Kauaʻi Bus Paratransit Service
Region/Service Area: Island of Kauaʻi (Kauaʻi County), HI — corridor served by fixed routes from Hanalei to Kekaha, hub at Līhuʻe
Fare: Differing fares by category (ADA, senior, adult, youth); seniors with Kupuna Care and Personal Care Attendants ride free
Ridership/Performance Notes: Shared-ride, curb-to-curb origin-to-destination service for registered seniors (65+; 10 trips/month, with work and dialysis exemptions), Kupuna Care Transportation seniors, and ADA-certified riders. Reservations required no later than 4:30 PM the day prior.

Name: TheHandi-Van
Region/Service Area: Island of Oʻahu (islandwide), City & County of Honolulu, HI
Operator: Oahu Transit Services, Inc. (OTS) for the City & County of Honolulu Dept. of Transportation Services
Fare: $2.50 per one-way trip effective 7/1/2026 (was $2.25); $2.00 low-income; no charge for PCA or service animal; paid via TheHandi-Van HOLO Card
Service Hours: Islandwide; 24-hour service available within 3/4 mile of TheBus Routes 2 and 40
Funding Source: Federal, Local (City & County of Honolulu; ADA complementary paratransit)
Ridership/Performance Notes: ADA complementary paratransit for riders unable to independently use TheBus; curb-to-curb shared ride. Reserve 1 to 3 days ahead; reservations (808) 456-5555; eligibility (808) 538-0033.

Name: DART Bus Plus (Paratransit)
Region/Service Area: Des Moines metro DART member cities (Base and Premium Service Zones): Altoona, Ankeny, Bondurant, Clive, Des Moines, Johnston, Urbandale, West Des Moines, Windsor Heights, and unincorporated Polk County
Operator: Des Moines Area Regional Transit Authority (DART)
Booking Method(s): Phone (515-283-8136); reservations accepted up to 7 days ahead (Base Zone), until 5 p.m. weekdays / 4 p.m. weekends the day before
Fare: $3.50 per trip in Base Service Zone; $30 per trip in Premium Service Zone (Premium trips are non-Medicaid only)
Service Hours: Comparable to DART fixed route: approx. Mon-Fri 5 a.m.-11 p.m., Sat 6 a.m.-10 p.m., Sun 7 a.m.-7 p.m.; reservation line Mon-Fri 8 a.m.-5 p.m.
Ridership/Performance Notes: ADA door-to-door complementary paratransit; riders must apply and be certified via a DART Bus Service Eligibility Form with medical/qualified-professional verification (results within 21 days). Premium Service Zone (added Nov 2023) extends coverage to full member-community boundaries. Approved riders also ride DART fixed route free.

Name: DART On Demand
Region/Service Area: Des Moines metro — Ankeny microtransit zone (active); Clive, Urbandale and Altoona zones planned fall 2026 under Reimagine DART
Operator: Des Moines Area Regional Transit Authority (DART)
Fare: $3.50 standard; $0.75 half-fare and children ages 6-10; pay via DART On Demand app, myDART app, DART pass/tokens, or exact change
Service Hours: Ankeny zone: Monday–Friday 6:00 a.m.–6:30 p.m. (last trip booking 6:15 p.m.)
Ridership/Performance Notes: Point-to-point on-demand shared rides within a defined zone using smaller buses; trips can be booked in real-time or scheduled in advance and may be shared. Ankeny zone runs as-is until Sept 28, 2026, then reconfigured Ankeny plus new Clive-Urbandale and Altoona zones launch fall 2026 under Reimagine DART. Ankeny zone bounds: NE 62nd Ave (south), SE Four Mile Dr (east), 36th St (north), SW Irvinedale Dr (west).

Name: Dial-A-Ride (ADA Paratransit)
Region/Service Area: City of Ames (and within 3/4 mile of CyRide fixed routes)
Operator: CyRide (operated under contract by Heart of Iowa Regional Transit Agency / HIRTA)
Fare: $2 per ride; Personal Care Attendant rides free, companion pays same fare
Service Hours: Operates during all hours CyRide fixed routes are running
Ridership/Performance Notes: ADA complementary paratransit for riders unable to use fixed-route buses due to a disability; requires application/eligibility approval (up to 21 days). Door-to-door service booked by phone through HIRTA (1-877-686-0029); same-day trips accepted if time and space allow, otherwise scheduled in advance. Wheelchair lift-equipped service available.

Name: EASE (East Ames Service Extension)
Region/Service Area: East Ames on-demand zone, Ames, IA (pickups within EASE zone plus Ames City Hall)
Operator: CyRide (City of Ames / Iowa State University transit)
Fare: $1.00 per trip (same as regular CyRide bus fare)
Ridership/Performance Notes: Curb-to-curb on-demand service; riders use the Ride Pingo app or call CyRide (515-239-5600, at least 30 min ahead for call-ins). Pingo platform launched with CyRide Dec 2022 — The Routing Company's first Midwest on-demand agency partnership. Two-year TRC contract awarded Oct 2022; agency reported improved efficiency, reduced call-center volume, high rider satisfaction. Transfers to fixed routes at City Hall.

Name: HIRTA On-Demand
Region/Service Area: Boone, Dallas, Jasper, Madison, Marion, Story and Warren counties (central Iowa)
Operator: Heart of Iowa Regional Transit Agency (HIRTA)
Service Hours: Mon-Fri 7:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m. (Story County from 6:30 a.m.)
Fleet: ADA-accessible / wheelchair-lift-equipped vehicles (fleet size not specified)
Ridership/Performance Notes: General public, any trip purpose; same-day or advance booking; pickups within a 20-minute window, door-to-door across seven counties. HIRTA is an FTA ITS4US complete-trip deployment site.

Name: LIFTS (Linn County Paratransit)
Region/Service Area: Cedar Rapids, Marion, and Hiawatha metro plus rural Linn County communities (Alburnett, Center Point, Central City, Coggon, Ely, Fairfax, Lisbon, Mount Vernon, Palo, Robins, Springville, Walker, etc.), Iowa
Operator: Linn County, Iowa (Linn County Community Services / LIFTS)
Fare: $3.00 one-way for seniors/persons with disabilities; $6.00 one-way general public (rural only); personal care attendant free
Service Hours: Weekdays 5:15 a.m.-8 p.m. (metro) / 7 a.m.-5 p.m. (rural); Saturday 8 a.m.-5 p.m. (metro only); no Sunday service
Ridership/Performance Notes: Door-to-door demand-response paratransit; metro service restricted to ADA-eligible seniors and persons with disabilities (eligibility administered via Cedar Rapids Transit), rural communities open to general public. Reservations by phone (319-892-5170) up to 7-30 days in advance, at least one day prior. Distinct from Cedar Rapids Transit's own ADA paratransit.

Name: MET ParaTransit
Region/Service Area: Waterloo and Cedar Falls (Black Hawk County), Iowa
Operator: Metropolitan Transit Authority of Black Hawk County (MET Transit)
Fare: $3.00 one-way (sheet of ten tickets $30.00; PCA rides free)
Service Hours: Mon-Fri 5:45 AM-6:45 PM; Sat 6:45 AM-5:45 PM
Ridership/Performance Notes: Door-to-door service for people whose disability prevents use of MET fixed-route buses; complementary ADA paratransit. Reservations required 1 to 14 days in advance by phone at (319) 234-5714.

Name: MuscaBus ParaTransit
Fare: $2.00 per ride (sheet of 12 tickets $24.00; personal care attendants ride free)
Ridership/Performance Notes: Eligibility-restricted paratransit for individuals unable to access the fixed route bus due to disability; day-ahead phone reservation required (call 263-8152); complements MuscaBus fixed colored routes. Candidate's 'open to the general public / not eligibility-restricted' claim is contradicted by the official ParaTransit page, which limits it to riders unable to use fixed routes due to disability.

Name: Peoplerides
Region/Service Area: Hardin, Marshall, Poweshiek and Tama counties, Iowa
Fare: In-town $2-$15 depending on county/city; out-of-town demand-response $2.89 per mile
Ridership/Performance Notes: Established 1974; open to the general public including persons with disabilities; provides 50,000+ rides annually across the four counties using 20 ADA-accessible vehicles; offers both route and demand-response trips. Advance booking (at least one day) receives priority; same-day depends on driver availability. Medicaid-funded trips booked via broker (MTM); Marshalltown paratransit requires prior approval.

Name: Region 8 Regional Transit Authority (RTA) On-Demand
Region/Service Area: Delaware, Dubuque (excl. City of Dubuque) and Jackson counties, northeast Iowa (Planning Area 8)
Fleet: ~30 light-duty buses and accessible minivans; transitioning to 9-passenger vans
Ridership/Performance Notes: Modernized rural demand-response using QRyde booking/routing/scheduling platform; ~100,000 passenger trips annually serving ~2,500 individuals. Advance reservations typically requested 24h ahead; same-day available subject to availability; ~10-min-out arrival notifications. Open to the general public; all vehicles wheelchair accessible.

Name: River Bend Transit
Region/Service Area: Cedar, Clinton, Muscatine and Scott counties (Iowa Quad Cities region)
Fare: Not specified (varies by county/contract; per-county fare cards; same-day trips at premium; veterans ride free)
Service Hours: Varies by service; Bettendorf Dial-A-Bus Mon-Fri 6 a.m.-6 p.m., Sat 8:45 a.m.-5:40 p.m.
Ridership/Performance Notes: Iowa's first regional consolidated transit system (est. 1978); general-public door-to-door demand-response serving seniors, people with disabilities, and the general public across the Iowa Quad Cities; also offers same-day service (premium fare), county services, low-income employment transportation, and contracted city services (e.g. Bettendorf Dial-A-Bus). FTA transit agency profile ID 70049.

Name: SEIBUS (Southeast Iowa Bus)
Region/Service Area: Des Moines, Henry, Lee and Louisa counties, southeast Iowa
Fare: $3.00 in-town one-way; $15–$30 medical shuttle; monthly passes offered by county (per Iowa DOT / SEIBUS)
Service Hours: Monday–Friday, 6:00 AM–4:00 PM (county availability windows ~9:00 AM–3:00 PM)
Fleet: Wheelchair-lift-equipped buses; fleet size not specified
Ridership/Performance Notes: On-demand curb-to-curb demand-response with no fixed routes; open to the general public including persons with disabilities; advance booking required — appointments must be made no later than 2:00 PM the day prior to departure (no same-day). Iowa DOT classifies it as Demand-Response, Subscription. Ridership figures not found.

Name: SWITA (Southwest Iowa Transit Agency)
Region/Service Area: Cass, Fremont, Harrison, Mills, Montgomery, Page, Pottawattamie and Shelby counties, SW Iowa
Service Hours: Mon-Fri 6:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m. (vehicles operate 24/7 pending availability)
Ridership/Performance Notes: Public on-demand rideshare open to all residents of eight SW Iowa counties; also offers student, medical, work-route, taxi and excursion services. On-demand rides 6a-5p weekdays.

Name: Sioux City Transit ADA Paratransit
Region/Service Area: City of Sioux City, IA (within city limits; ADA complementary to fixed route)
Operator: Sioux City Transit System (reservations handled by Siouxland Regional Transit System / SRTS)
Fare: $3.60 per one-way trip (twice the fixed-route adult fare) per City of Sioux City; SRTS brochure lists $4.00 curb-to-curb / $7.00 door-to-door
Ridership/Performance Notes: Origin-to-destination accessible service for individuals unable to use fixed-route transit due to functional ability (ADA complementary paratransit). Reservations must be made the day prior to the trip via SRTS (712) 279-6919. Fare figure differs between City site ($3.60) and SRTS brochure ($4.00/$7.00).

Name: Siouxland Regional Transit System (SRTS)
Region/Service Area: Cherokee, Ida, Monona, Plymouth and Woodbury counties (IA); southern Union County, SD; Dakota County, NE
Service Hours: Mon-Sat 5:30 a.m.-7:00 p.m.; closed major holidays
Fleet: ADA-accessible buses (seat belts); fleet size not specified
Ridership/Performance Notes: Demand-responsive, ADA-accessible public transit open to the general public; curb-to-curb and door-to-door service; reservations requested ~24 hours in advance by phone.

Name: The Jule MiniBus (ADA Paratransit)
Region/Service Area: City of Dubuque and East Dubuque, IA
Ridership/Performance Notes: ADA complementary / senior (65+) eligibility-restricted door-to-door paratransit operated alongside The Jule's fixed routes. Trips must be scheduled at least 1 day and up to 14 days in advance. Dispatch: 563-690-6464. Personal care attendant rides free.

Name: Trip Connect (Johnson County)
Region/Service Area: Iowa City, Coralville, University Heights, North Liberty, Tiffin, and all parts of Johnson County north of I-80 (evening service)
Operator: Horizons NTS (Neighborhood Transportation Service), contracted by Johnson County Social Services
Funding Source: Local (Johnson County, City of North Liberty, Kirkwood Community College), State (Iowa DOT special projects grant), National Center for Mobility Management grant, passenger revenue
Ridership/Performance Notes: Curb-to-curb on-demand or scheduled evening rides for workers/students; launched Dec 11, 2024; completed 4,200+ rides; pilot ended June 30, 2026 due to ~$350k/yr funding shortfall.

Name: Mountain Rides Dial-a-Ride
Region/Service Area: Blaine County, ID: Ketchum, Sun Valley, Hailey, Bellevue
Ridership/Performance Notes: Curb-to-curb paratransit available to qualifying individuals within the Mountain Rides service area; booked by phone (208-788-7433 x106). Agency otherwise runs fare-free fixed-route buses.

Name: Pocatello Regional Transit Door-to-Door Services
Region/Service Area: Pocatello/Chubbuck urban area plus seven surrounding counties (Bannock, Bear Lake, Bingham, Caribou, Franklin, Oneida, Power) in Idaho Transportation District #5, southeast Idaho
Operator: City of Pocatello / Pocatello Regional Transit (PRT)
Booking Method(s): Phone (208-234-2287); NEMT trips booked via MTM (1-877-503-1261)
Ridership/Performance Notes: Agency's Door-to-Door Services page states service is NOT open to the general public; eligibility limited to ADA-qualified riders unable to use fixed route, Medicaid/NEMT-eligible riders, seniors 60+ with health/functional limitations, and rural residents in outlying counties without fixed-route coverage. Reclassified from candidate's Demand-Response to Paratransit. Vendor, fares, hours, funding, launch year not confirmed from source.

Name: SMART Transit Dial-A-Ride
Region/Service Area: Twin Falls and Jerome area (south-central Idaho)
Operator: SMART Transit (South Central Community Action Partnership)
Ridership/Performance Notes: General-public Dial-A-Ride demand-response; priority given to ADA riders and seniors 60+, then general public. Phone reservations only; same-day reservations not accepted (advance booking required). Shared-ride, ADA wheelchair accessible, fare-free.

Name: Valley Regional Transit ACCESS Paratransit
Region/Service Area: Within 3/4 mile of VRT fixed-route service, Treasure Valley (Ada and Canyon counties / Boise metro), ID
Fare: $3 per trip (certified passenger); PCA free; companion $3
Service Hours: Mirrors VRT fixed-route service hours; reservations Mon-Fri 8am-5pm, Sat by voicemail
Ridership/Performance Notes: ADA complementary paratransit for riders unable to use fixed-route/on-demand bus due to disability; trips booked up to 14 days ahead, no later than 5pm for next operating day. Operated by VRT via local municipal tax support. Related VRT specialized services (Beyond Access, City Go, Rides2Wellness, Volunteer Driver Program, VRT Late Night, VRT Lyft Pass) not individually verified here.

Name: Access Johnson County Public Transit
Region/Service Area: Johnson County, IN (zone-to-zone countywide; Franklin, Greenwood, etc.)
Ridership/Performance Notes: General-public demand-response ('Demand Response and Flexible Fixed Route service'); reservations by phone (317-738-5523) or the 'Trip Portal' smartphone app for registered riders; all vehicles wheelchair accessible; ADA paratransit certification available separately.

Name: Access219 Paratransit
Region/Service Area: City of Gary plus 3/4 mile beyond fixed routes in Calumet Township, Crown Point, East Chicago, Griffith, Hammond, Highland, Hobart, Merrillville, and Munster (Lake County)
Fare: $2.50 one-way within Gary; $4.00 one-way outside Gary; 20-ride local pass $50; 12-ride non-local pass $48
Ridership/Performance Notes: ADA-complementary paratransit for riders unable to use GPTC fixed routes; three ADA eligibility categories (I/II/III).

Name: BLink
Region/Service Area: Within Bloomington city limits (Downtown, East, and North zones); serves trips not within walkable distance of a fixed bus route
Fare: $2 per one-way trip; pay in-app, cash (exact change), Tap To Pay, or Umo card
Ridership/Performance Notes: No eligibility or application required; rides booked on demand or up to 24 hours in advance. Repeated no-shows/late cancellations may result in booking restrictions.

Name: BT Access
Region/Service Area: City of Bloomington incorporated boundaries (Monroe County, IN)
Service Hours: Mon-Fri 6:00am-11:59pm; Sat/Sun varies seasonally (7:30am-9:30pm during IU semesters)
Ridership/Performance Notes: ADA complementary paratransit for persons with disabilities who cannot use fixed-route service; trips bookable up to 14 days in advance, same-day as capacity permits; reciprocal visitor eligibility up to 21 days.

Name: Citilink Access
Region/Service Area: Fort Wayne (within 3/4 mile of fixed routes; Access Plus to Fort Wayne city limits)
Fare: $3.00 (Access); $4.50 or $4.28 via Token Transit (Access Plus expanded zone)
Service Hours: No service Sundays/holidays; reservation phone staffed 5:30 AM-8:30 PM weekdays, 7:30 AM-5:30 PM Saturdays
Ridership/Performance Notes: Demand-response van service for riders with disabilities who meet ADA eligibility (application with 21-day determination) and are unable to use fixed-route service. Reservations recommended up to 14 days ahead, required by 5 PM prior day.

Name: CityBus ACCESS
Region/Service Area: Greater Lafayette (Lafayette / West Lafayette, Tippecanoe County) ADA complementary service area
Ridership/Performance Notes: ADA complementary paratransit for eligible individuals unable to use fixed-route buses; listed as a distinct service on the official CityBus site. CityBus also runs FLEX flexible-routing and CityVan services (excluded here). Ridership/performance figures not verified.

Name: Hamilton County Express
Region/Service Area: Hamilton County, IN (Carmel, Fishers, Noblesville, Westfield and contiguous counties)
Service Hours: Mon-Fri 6:00am-6:00pm; Sat 7:00am-3:00pm; closed major holidays (booking line Mon-Fri 8am-4pm)
Ridership/Performance Notes: General-public demand-response (reservation-based) transit in Hamilton County; open to individuals with disabilities and the general public; connects to contiguous counties. Booking via 317-773-2688.

Name: IndyGo Access
Region/Service Area: Marion County, IN (ADA service area within 3/4 mile of fixed routes; extended coverage countywide)
Operator: IndyGo (Indianapolis Public Transportation Corporation); operated under contract by MV Transportation
Fare: $5.50 within 3/4 mile of fixed route; $11.00 beyond (countywide); $15.00 same-day Premium Service Area (effective July 1, 2026)
Service Hours: Seven days a week, same hours as local fixed-route service
Ridership/Performance Notes: ADA complementary paratransit for riders unable to use fixed-route service; same-day trips within Premium Service Area added July 1, 2026 based on vehicle/operator capacity.

Name: METS Micro
Region/Service Area: City of Evansville, Indiana (designated on-demand zones; expanding to Jacobsville)
Ridership/Performance Notes: Launched Nov 27, 2023; completed over 37,000 rides by first anniversary (Nov 2024). Powered by Via; supported by Toyota Mobility Foundation, Evansville MPO, and Energy Systems Network. Curb-to-curb; booking by app or phone (812-562-5011). Expanding to Jacobsville.

Name: MITSPlus
Region/Service Area: Muncie, IN (ADA complementary paratransit service area)
Service Hours: Mon-Fri 6:15 AM-6:45 PM; Sat 8:15 AM-6:15 PM; Sun closed
Ridership/Performance Notes: Origin-to-destination van service for persons with disabilities unable to use MITS fixed-route bus; eligibility requires two-part application with professional assessment (ADA complementary paratransit).

Name: Transpo Access
Region/Service Area: South Bend / Mishawaka; within 3/4 mile of Transpo fixed-route service area
Fare: $2.00 per trip leg (twice fixed-route fare, per ADA)
Ridership/Performance Notes: ADA complementary paratransit for riders with disabilities certified under DOT eligibility criteria; service limited to within 3/4 mile of fixed routes.

Name: Lawrence Transit On Demand
Region/Service Area: City limits of Lawrence, Douglas County, KS (curb-to-curb, citywide zone)
Operator: Lawrence Transit (City of Lawrence / University of Kansas partnership)
Fare: $3 one-way (credit/debit only, no cash), effective March 1, 2026
Service Hours: Daytime: 8 a.m.–6 p.m. Sunday; Nighttime: 8 p.m.–6 a.m. Mon–Sat and 12 a.m.–6 a.m. Sunday
Fleet: Smaller buses, all ADA accessible and equipped with bike racks (count not specified)
Ridership/Performance Notes: Curb-to-curb on-demand shared-ride service open to the general public, book any two points in town; booked via Lawrence Transit On Demand app (Spare, iOS/Android) or phone (785) 312-7054. Ridership/performance data not published on site.

Name: Night Line
Region/Service Area: Within Lawrence city limits, Douglas County, KS
Fare: $2 cash only per trip (passes not accepted)
Ridership/Performance Notes: Evening/overnight curb-to-curb on-demand service open to the general public; rides scheduled by phone in advance during business hours (8 a.m.–5 p.m.) rather than fixed-stop. Originally launched as a one-year pilot on June 1, 2013; still listed as a core Lawrence Transit service.

Name: RideKC Freedom On-Demand (Kansas portion)
Region/Service Area: Johnson County and Wyandotte County, Kansas (part of the RideKC Kansas City metro service area)
Operator: Kansas City Area Transportation Authority (RideKC / KCATA)
Fare: $5.00 for the first 5 miles, $2.00 per mile after that
Ridership/Performance Notes: Same-day curb-to-curb on-demand mobility service for RideKC Freedom (paratransit) eligible riders; unlike traditional paratransit, no day-ahead scheduling is required for eligible trips. Kansas-side coverage includes all of Johnson County and Wyandotte County; also serves Kansas City and Independence, Missouri.

Name: The Lift (Topeka Metro Paratransit)
Region/Service Area: City of Topeka, Shawnee County, KS (ADA service area matching fixed-route coverage)
Service Hours: Same days/times as fixed route (Mon-Fri 5:35am-6:40pm; Sat 8:15am-6:40pm)
Ridership/Performance Notes: ADA complementary paratransit for qualified passengers unable to use Topeka Metro fixed-route service; operates same days/times as fixed route. Reservations via (785) 783-7000.

Name: Wichita Transit Paratransit
Region/Service Area: City of Wichita, Sedgwick County (ADA service area, incl. within 3/4 mile of fixed routes)
Ridership/Performance Notes: ADA complementary paratransit for persons with physical, cognitive, or visual disabilities functionally unable to use fixed-route buses; eligibility via application, interview, and functional assessment. Trips scheduled day-before, up to 7 days in advance; same-day subject to availability. Extended evening service within 3/4 mile of fixed routes.

Name: Jefferson Parish Transit MITS (Mobility Impaired Transportation System)
Region/Service Area: Jefferson Parish and Orleans Parish, LA (urbanized Jefferson Parish incl. Eastbank, developed Westbank north of Hero Cutoff, and Lafitte, plus all of Orleans Parish)
Operator: Jefferson Parish Transit (JP Transit), operated under contract by Transdev, Inc.
Fare: $3.00 each way (personal care attendants ride free)
Service Hours: Seven days a week; hours coincide with daily fixed-route service
Ridership/Performance Notes: ADA complementary paratransit curb-to-curb service; riders must complete an application and healthcare-professional evaluation to be certified eligible for permanent, temporary, or intermittent disabilities preventing fixed-route bus use. Dispatch line 504-889-7194; eligibility line 504-889-7155.

Name: LYNX Microtransit (CATS LYNX)
Launch Year: 2022 (approximate — sourced from a 'reported 4-year partnership' reference as of March 2026, not a confirmed exact date)
Ridership/Performance Notes: General-public, on-demand microtransit in Baker zone; CATS materials cite award recognition and cumulative ridership near 430,000 rides across LYNX + growing ADA paratransit service (combined figure, not LYNX-only). CATS also runs a separate 'CATS on Demand' service (~10,000 rides/month) whose relationship to LYNX is unclear from available sources.

Name: Monroe Transit System (MTS) Paratransit Services
Fare: Not specified ($2.50/trip reported for eligible paratransit riders per secondary source, unverified)
Ridership/Performance Notes: City of Monroe transit department page titled 'MTS Paratransit Services' (also references 'MTS On Demand'). Included as ADA-mandated complementary paratransit for Monroe's fixed-route bus system. Could not confirm via fetch whether 'MTS On Demand' is a separate general-public same-day microtransit product distinct from ADA dispatch — flag for follow-up research pass with fresh search budget; both WebFetch attempts on the source page returned truncated content.

Name: RTA Paratransit Service (LIFT)
Service Hours: 24 hours a day, every day (including holidays)
Ridership/Performance Notes: ADA-certified riders only (RTA Paratransit Card required via ADA eligibility application, doctor verification needed). Shared-ride service; trips can take up to 90 minutes. Reservations must be made for next-day service or up to 5 days in advance; minimum 1 hour between consecutive trips. Reservation line: 504-827-7433 (Mon-Fri 8am-5pm, Sat-Sun 8am-4pm).

Name: River Parishes Transit Authority (RPTA) On-Demand Service
Region/Service Area: St. Charles, St. James, and St. John the Baptist parishes, LA
Technology Vendor: Not specified (branded as "Link-Microtransit" booking platform; underlying vendor company not confirmed)
Funding Source: Not specified (RPTA created by Louisiana legislation as a regional transit authority; funding mechanism not confirmed)
Ridership/Performance Notes: Live booking portal (fetched directly) confirms an on-demand ride service in the three river parishes; riders must call dispatch (985-233-4339) before their first booking, then book via app/phone. Portal text states a 'pre-booking is required...based on available schedules,' which is somewhat ambiguous — could not fully confirm a pure no-fixed-schedule same-day model vs. a windowed reservation system. Fare/hours/fleet/vendor/funding not confirmed this pass.

Name: SporTran OnDemand
Fleet: Not specified (Dodge Caravans, Chevy Malibu and Dodge Challenger sedans mentioned, no total count)
Ridership/Performance Notes: General-public on-demand service branded 'Powered by the RideCo Transit App'; zone-based with designated stops, service area shown on interactive map; also used for ADA-eligible trips but not restricted to them.

Name: SporTran OnDemand Paratransit Services
Region/Service Area: Shreveport / Bossier City, Caddo and Bossier parishes, LA
Fare: Free under Zero Fare program as of 2022-2023 per agency site; current fare not confirmed
Service Hours: 5:00 AM-1:15 AM Mon-Sat, 8:00 AM-5:00 PM Sun (same as fixed-route); closed major holidays
Ridership/Performance Notes: ADA/disability-eligibility paratransit service; three eligibility categories tied to inability to use fixed-route bus service; reservations required, made up to 14 days in advance or for the next day; operates alongside SporTran fixed-route system with wheelchair lifts/ramps.

Name: Lynx (Penquis Transportation)
Region/Service Area: Penobscot and Piscataquis Counties, ME (excluding Patten)
Fare: Varies by distance traveled; no general-public pass offered
Service Hours: Not specified (service operates at least one day per week in each town within its area)
Fleet: Agency vans, volunteer drivers, and taxi services (fleet size not specified)
Ridership/Performance Notes: Demand-response transportation serving Penobscot and Piscataquis Counties (excluding Patten), operated by the Penquis community action agency. Requires 3 business days' advance notice to schedule a ride. Open to the general public, with additional coordinated services for elderly, MaineCare recipients, veterans, and people with disabilities. Contact: 207-973-3695 or 1-866-853-5969.

Name: Metro Connect (Falmouth)
Operator: Greater Portland Metro (GPMetro / Greater Portland Transit District)
Service Hours: 7 days/week, circulating within Falmouth service zone (specific start/end times not specified)
Funding Source: Federal (ARPA) -- per 2024 GPMetro RFP for the on-demand transit pilot program; not explicitly reconfirmed in later coverage
Ridership/Performance Notes: GPMetro's first microtransit program; door-to-zone on-demand shuttle open to the general public, booked through the Spare Rider platform (vendor confirmed via booking URL). Per a Nov 2025 one-year-in review, averaging ~1 ride/hour with a goal of 2 rides/hour by end of 2025. Service area has expanded to cover most of Falmouth since a December 2024 launch.

Name: Mid-Coast Connector (WCAP Transportation Services)
Region/Service Area: Waldo, Knox, Lincoln, and Sagadahoc Counties, plus Brunswick and Harpswell, ME (fixed-route DASH service separately in Belfast/Rockland)
Fare: Not specified (varies by service type/distance; reduced fares for seniors, children under 17, and disabled riders reported for DASH and senior medical trips)
Ridership/Performance Notes: WCAP operates flex-route/demand-response service open to the general public plus MaineCare non-emergency medical transportation, distinct from its fixed-route DASH city bus service in Belfast/Rockland. Confirmed via Maine Transit Association member listing and WCAP's own program page.

Name: RTP (Regional Transportation Program)
Region/Service Area: Cumberland County, Maine (includes Lakes Region Explorer route between Bridgton and Portland)
Ridership/Performance Notes: Shared-ride demand-response service prioritizing elderly, disabled, and low-income riders but explicitly open to the general public; requires advance phone booking (same-day changes must be called in, not made online). Separately offers ADA-compliant paratransit (ADA Rider Application/Policy) not separately catalogued here.

Name: RTP Catch-A-Ride
Fare: $2.50 (same town/neighboring towns), $5.00 (non-adjoining towns); many riders qualify for free service via application
Ridership/Performance Notes: General-public, county-wide shared-ride demand-response service; RTP states it serves 'anyone' in Cumberland County on a space-available basis. NOT disability-restricted -- that description (people 'prevented by a disability from utilizing fixed-route bus service') applies to RTP's separate ADA paratransit program, not Catch-A-Ride. Booking is phone-only (774-2666 or 800-244-0704); no app booking found on the source page despite candidate's 'Phone, App' claim. Requires up to 2 weeks advance booking, minimum 2 business days notice -- not same-day.

Name: Standish-Gorham Microtransit Pilot
Region/Service Area: Standish and Gorham (RTP also serves Raymond, Windham, and a separate Harrison pilot), Cumberland County, ME
Ridership/Performance Notes: Launched October 15, 2025; same-day on-demand home pickup to any destination within service area. Funded through at least May 2026, with a $6 fare extension to downtown Portland reportedly proposed. Distinct from RTP's separate Harrison pilot ($99,576 grant) and from RTP's general advance-reservation (2+ business days) demand-response/paratransit service.

Name: Western Maine Transportation Services (WMTS)
Region/Service Area: Androscoggin, Oxford, and Franklin Counties, plus Bath and Brunswick, ME
Ridership/Performance Notes: Demand-response service open to the general public across three western Maine counties plus Bath/Brunswick; site also lists separate flex, fixed, and commuter routes (not in scope). Fares reported unchanged since Oct 1, 2019 (amount not specified).

Name: Coast Transit Authority ADA Paratransit
Region/Service Area: Harrison County, MS — within 3/4 mile of CTA's fixed-route corridors (Gulfport, Biloxi, Ocean Springs/Gulf Coast service area)
Fare: $2.00 per fare zone (zone-based, matches CTA fixed-route fare zones); 10-ride pass sheets available for $20
Service Hours: Reservation line open 8am-5pm, 7 days/week; requests taken 1 day to 14 days in advance; 1-hour cancellation notice required. Actual service operating hours not specified.
Ridership/Performance Notes: ADA complementary paratransit for riders who cannot use CTA's accessible fixed-route buses due to physical/mental impairment, boarding-assistance needs, or inability to reach a bus stop. Separate 'ADA Paratransit Plus' program also referenced on site but details not found in this pass. No ridership figures found.

Name: GEST (Liberty/Gladstone, MO)
Region/Service Area: Liberty, MO and Gladstone, MO (Northland Kansas City region); candidate also lists North Kansas City, Riverside, Parkville — unverified
Ridership/Performance Notes: General-public, door-to-door, on-demand service; replaced a discontinued IRIS microtransit service (IRIS ended late Sept 2025 due to rising costs). Liberty launched ~1 week before article, Gladstone ~1 month prior; Liberty saw a 140% week-over-week ridership increase and up to 50 rides/day expected; Gladstone completed 'hundreds of rides.' Liberty is running a 30-day pilot before deciding on contract extension. Vehicles are NOT ADA-compliant — riders needing accommodation are directed to Liberty Access Bus or separate GEST paratransit option. Some riders reported being unable to book rides despite operator claims of full availability.

Name: IRIS (Independence)
Region/Service Area: City of Independence, MO (entire city limits)
Operator: City of Independence (funder/project manager) / Kansas City Area Transportation Authority (KCATA, service manager) / zTrip (operations) / RideCo (technology)
Fare: $5.00 per person per trip (free to/from 4 designated transfer points: Independence Transit Center, Centerpoint Medical Center, Independence Municipal Commons, Blue Ridge transfer point)
Ridership/Performance Notes: Dynamic-routing microtransit covering entire Independence city limits, pickup/dropoff within ~1/4 mile of requested locations. Candidate's original fare ($3.00) and fleet ('Not specified') were incorrect/incomplete per official city source; corrected here. One secondary April 2025 news report suggested planned cessation May 1 2025, but the live official city page (checked July 2026) states the service is currently active — worth flagging in concerns.csv if added. Launch year conflicting (candidate: 2023; one news summary: Jan 2025) and unconfirmed from a primary source, left as Not specified.

Name: Metro Call-A-Ride
Region/Service Area: St. Louis city and St. Louis County, Missouri (Metro Transit / Bi-State Development service area)
Service Hours: Reservation line staffed 7:30 AM - 5:00 PM daily, including holidays; same-day trips possible if space permits; actual ride service operating hours not confirmed on official source
Ridership/Performance Notes: ADA complementary paratransit to MetroLink/MetroBus; shared-ride service with a 30-minute pickup window (actual pickup may be up to ~1 hour from requested time); riders must qualify for ADA paratransit eligibility; late cancellations/no-shows can result in suspension.

Name: OATS Transit (OATS, Inc.)
Region/Service Area: 87 counties across rural Missouri (statewide, excludes core areas of major metros like St. Louis and Kansas City)
Fleet: Not specified (cutaway buses referenced on site)
Ridership/Performance Notes: Largest rural transit provider in Missouri by county coverage (87 counties); 501(c)(3) nonprofit, self-described as open to 'people of all ages & abilities.' Confirmed founding tagline 'Missouri's Rural Transportation Provider Since 1971' and phone booking line (1-888-875-6287); an app is referenced but not detailed on the homepage. Exact scheduling window (same-day availability vs. strict advance-only reservation) not confirmed from pages fetched -- rider guide/FAQ/schedule pages 404'd and further web search was blocked by session search-budget exhaustion. Included per CLAUDE.md default (Advance-scheduling demand-response open to general public) but flagged for a follow-up verification pass.

Name: RideKC Freedom Paratransit
Region/Service Area: Kansas City metropolitan area, Missouri side — Jackson, Clay, and Platte counties served via KCATA (part of the broader multi-state RideKC Freedom paratransit network, which on the Kansas side also includes Unified Government Transit and Johnson County)
Ridership/Performance Notes: ADA complementary paratransit for older adults, people with disabilities, and people with low income whose functional ability prevents independent use of fixed-route bus service some or all of the time; eligibility may be temporary/conditional. Reservations must be made by 4:45 PM the day before travel, bookable up to 14 days out; subscription service available for recurring trips (up to 90 days); trip-time negotiation permitted within 60 minutes of requested time. Sibling Kansas-side zones (Wyandotte/Unified Government, Johnson County, Leavenworth-area IndeAccess) are out of scope for this Missouri pass.

Name: Via Metro STL
Region/Service Area: St. Louis County, MO (North, West/mid-county incl. Fenton, and South County zones)
Ridership/Performance Notes: ~24,000-25,000 rides/month as of early 2026; over 750,000 total rides completed since 2020 launch (up from ~2,000 rides/month in year one); trips capped at 7 miles; uses virtual bus stops to group riders; Bi-State Development allocated ~$6.34M to fund operation through May 31, 2026 — continuation beyond that date not confirmed as of current date (2026-07-23).

Name: Blackfeet Transit
Region/Service Area: Browning and the Blackfeet Reservation, Glacier County, MT (extended service to Kalispell, Great Falls, Shelby, Cut Bank)
Fare: $1 adults; free for seniors, passengers with disabilities, and children under 17 (with adult)
Ridership/Performance Notes: On-demand public transit "powered by Via"; uses real-time pooling algorithm to combine riders headed the same direction; app is "Blackfeet Transit" on Apple/Google Play; dispatcher line (406) 338-5604 for riders without smartphones.

Name: Dawson County Transit
Ridership/Performance Notes: Weekday dial-a-ride service; serves Dawson County High School, downtown Glendive, Glendive Dinosaur and Fossil Museum, Glendive Medical Center, and the Glendive bus stop. Phone reservation line (406) 377-5024.

Name: Dial-A-Ride Para-Transit Services (Butte-Silver Bow)
Region/Service Area: Butte-Silver Bow County, MT — service extends within/up to 1.5 miles of the Butte-Silver Bow Transit fixed-route system (Butte, Anaconda, Walkerville)
Fare: Free (Personal Care Attendants also ride free if approved)
Service Hours: Mon–Fri 6:45am–6:15pm; Sat 8:45am–4:15pm; closed Sundays and designated holidays
Ridership/Performance Notes: ADA complementary paratransit; door-to-door service for individuals unable to use the fixed-route system per ADA medical/legal eligibility criteria. Rides must be scheduled the day before travel. Operator does not enter riders' residences at pickup.

Name: Dillon City Bus
Region/Service Area: Dillon (and up to 1 mile beyond city limits), Beaverhead County, MT
Operator: City of Dillon (inferred from official domain; not explicitly named on page)
Funding Source: State (Montana DOT Operating Grant Program, TransADE), Local (donations)
Ridership/Performance Notes: Not specified

Name: Fort Peck Transit
Region/Service Area: Fort Peck Indian Reservation, MT (Poplar, Brockton, Fort Kipp, Wolf Point, Frazer, and Oswego)
Ridership/Performance Notes: Demand-response service within reservation communities, plus scheduled weekday round-trip routes (Fort Kipp<->Poplar, Frazer<->Poplar) and medical-appointment trips outside the reservation area.

Name: Galavan
Region/Service Area: Bozeman, Belgrade, and Three Forks, Gallatin County, MT
Operator: HRDC (Human Resource Development Council District IX)
Fare: $2.00 donation per ride appreciated but never required (confirmed directly on HRDC's own transportation page)
Ridership/Performance Notes: Door-to-door transportation for adults 60+ and persons with disabilities unable to use Streamline transit, for medical appointments, grocery shopping, and essential errands. Riders schedule by calling (406) 587-2434 at least one business day in advance; new riders complete an intake form via mail/email/fax. Region confirmed as Bozeman/Belgrade/Three Forks only — candidate's claim of Livingston/Park County coverage under this same program name is unconfirmed; HRDC lists a separate Livingston contact (406-333-2537) suggesting that may be a distinct program.

Name: MET Plus (ADA Paratransit)
Region/Service Area: Billings city limits and within 3/4 mile of MET Transit fixed bus routes (Yellowstone County), MT
Booking Method(s): Phone (406-657-8218) during business hours; requires prior application and medical-professional certification (approval within 21 days)
Fare: $3.50 per one-way trip; cash, check, credit card, or prepaid account
Service Hours: Weekdays 5:50 AM-7:45 PM; Saturdays 8:10 AM-6:10 PM; closed Sundays and major holidays
Ridership/Performance Notes: ADA complementary paratransit; eligibility requires a disabling condition preventing use of MET's fixed-route bus service, verified via medical professional on application; curb-to-curb service; rides requested first-come, first-served during operating hours.

Name: Mountain Climber (formerly Eagle Transit)
Region/Service Area: Flathead County (Kalispell, Whitefish, Columbia Falls), MT
Operator: Flathead County Agency on Aging (unverified this pass)
Booking Method(s): Phone (dispatch call-in); on-demand app reported as forthcoming in earlier announcements, not confirmed live)
Fare: $1.00 per ride (reintroduced July 2023 after ~3 years fare-free)
Service Hours: Monday-Friday, 7am-7pm (per secondary source, unverified this pass)
Fleet: ADA-compliant vehicles with wheelchair lifts (per secondary source, unverified this pass); some vehicles reported to include ski storage bins for Whitefish Mountain Resort service
Ridership/Performance Notes: Rebranded from Eagle Transit to Mountain Climber in early 2021. Reported ~96% met-demand rate and 51,975 rides in the most recent fiscal year cited. Also handles NEMT trips as part of its service mix, but the core on-demand service is open to the general public (not eligibility-restricted) — reclassified from Paratransit to Demand-Response on that basis. Direct fetch of flathead.mt.gov timed out twice this pass; classification and all secondary-sourced fields still need confirmation against a primary county source.

Name: Mountain Line Paratransit
Region/Service Area: Missoula Urban Transportation District service area, Missoula, MT
Booking Method(s): Application-based; reservation method not specified in source
Ridership/Performance Notes: ADA complementary paratransit for individuals unable to use fixed-route buses due to disability; eligibility can be unconditional, conditional, seasonal, or temporary. Determination required within 21 days of application (temporary service provided while pending); visitors from other ADA-eligible systems get 21 days of service while applying.

Name: Powell County Transit
Region/Service Area: Powell County, MT (Deer Lodge); regional trips to Butte, Anaconda, Missoula, and Helena
Fare: $1 for local trips up to $40 for trips to Missoula
Ridership/Performance Notes: Not specified

Name: Richland County Transportation (RCT)
Region/Service Area: Richland County, MT (Sidney, Fairview, Lambert, Savage)
Operator: Richland County Transit (RCT), a county-operated service
Service Hours: Bus service Mon-Fri 7:00am-6:00pm in Sidney; other county towns (Fairview, Lambert, Savage) served at least once weekly; office hours Mon-Fri 8am-5pm
Fleet: 10 ADA-accessible vehicles (integrated car seats, bike racks, wheelchair securement)
Ridership/Performance Notes: Open to general public of all ages; passengers under 8 cannot ride unattended. No fare charged. Coordinator: Christie Steinley.

Name: Rocky Boy Transit
Region/Service Area: Rocky Boy's Indian Reservation, Hill/Chouteau County, MT
Funding Source: Federal (FTA Tribal Transit Program grant MT2025024)
Ridership/Performance Notes: North Central Montana coordination plan (2024) notes the tribal transit agency added on-demand service for reservation residents. Independently corroborated by federal grant record MT2025024, which funds continuation of both fixed-route and demand-response transit on the Rocky Boy Reservation, serving the general reservation community (employment, retail, medical, daily activities) rather than an ADA/senior-restricted rider pool.

Name: Sanders County Transportation
Region/Service Area: Sanders County, MT (Dixon, Heron, Hot Springs, Noxon, Plains, Thompson Falls, Trout Creek)
Ridership/Performance Notes: Not specified

Name: Valley County Transit
Fare: $1 each way within Glasgow; $3 each way outside Glasgow (premium fares apply for night/weekend service)
Service Hours: Weekday daytime service; night and weekend service available at premium fare
Ridership/Performance Notes: Not specified

Name: MATBUS Paratransit
Region/Service Area: Fargo, ND and Moorhead, MN metro area
Operator: Metro Area Transit (MATBUS) — joint Fargo/Moorhead public transit system (Cities of Fargo & Moorhead)
Fare: Not specified (see 'Cost to Ride Paratransit' page on matbus.com)
Fleet: Not specified (wheelchair-accessible vehicles per operator site)
Ridership/Performance Notes: ADA-certified complementary paratransit to MATBUS fixed-route service; riders must be certified ADA-eligible and age 7+; not open to general public.

Name: Souris Basin Transportation (SBT)
Region/Service Area: Minot and surrounding counties: Burke, Bottineau, McHenry, Mountrail, Pierce, Renville, and Ward County, ND
Operator: Souris Basin Transportation (regional transportation/economic development agency)
Fare: Not specified (site describes fares only as "low"/"most affordable", no dollar amount)
Ridership/Performance Notes: Agency website states "Anyone Can Ride" (open to general public, not eligibility-restricted). Phone reservations required within 24 hours of desired ride time. Site indicates active hiring of drivers, consistent with an ongoing operating service.
